description: A React functional component for monitoring and performing health checks on machine learning models. The component displays model health statuses, allows running individual or bulk health checks, and shows detailed error or response modals.

methods.name: extractMeaningfulError
methods.description: Extracts and standardizes error messages from various error data, matching known error patterns and mapping status codes.

methods.name: runIndividualHealthCheck
methods.description: Performs a health check on a specific model and updates the status based on the response or errors.

methods.name: runAllHealthChecks
methods.description: Triggers health checks on all selected models or all models on proxy, concurrently, and updates their statuses.

methods.name: handleModelSelection
methods.description: Updates the list of currently selected models for health checking based on user interaction.

methods.name: handleSelectAll
methods.description: Selects or deselects all models for health checks.

methods.name: getStatusBadge
methods.description: Returns a visual badge component representing the health status.

methods.name: showErrorModal
methods.description: Displays a modal with detailed error information for a specific model.

methods.name: showSuccessModal
methods.description: Displays a modal with detailed response information for a specific model.
